rolePicker.faq1Q: Does PawNail Jobs charge any fees?
rolePicker.faq1A: No. Signing up, posting jobs, browsing portfolios and messaging are all free.
rolePicker.faq2Q: Will my phone number be exposed?
rolePicker.faq2A: A tech's phone is only shown to a salon owner after they unlock the contact. Phone numbers on job posts are published by the owner on purpose.
rolePicker.faq3Q: Can I use it in Australia?
rolePicker.faq3A: Yes. The app supports both the US and Australia — pick your market when signing up.
rolePicker.faq4Q: How do I delete my account?
rolePicker.faq4A: Go to Account → Delete account. Your profile and the messages you sent are permanently removed.
